description: Agent Knowledge: submit one knowledge entry: its id, the claim as written, its source with its name, where a reader finds it (a URL, a document id with its page or section, or a record id), its kind and whether a reader outside the agent can open it, the date the claim holds for, the scope it applies to (where and to whom), its review date and its expiry date; and optionally the moment to read it at. The signed report reads the entry piece by piece, the claim, the source, the date, the scope and the review, giving each as present, missing or present with a gap, and names each missing piece: no source, no date, no scope, and no review or expiry date; then a source marked as one no reader outside the agent can open, a review or expiry date already past at the reading moment, and a claim that says always, never, all, every or guaranteed, wider than any one source can show, with the fix for each. A worked sample entry done right beside a flawed one is wever_knowledge-entry-sample and the packet checklist is wever_knowledge-snapshot, both on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Where one stored memory came from is wever_memory-provenance-check, and which agent took an action under which authorization is wever_actor-attribution-check in Agent Accountability. Verdict entry_incomplete, entry_gaps, entry_unverified or entry_complete. POST /api/knowledge-entry-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-knowledge-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-knowledge/.

as_of.description: The moment to read the entry at.

claim.description: The claim as the entry states it.

date.description: When the claim was true or published.

review_by.description: When the entry is due for review.

scope.description: Where and to whom the claim applies, such as EU store orders.

checkable.description: A reader outside the agent can open it and find the claim.

location.description: A URL, a document id with its page or section, or a record id.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_knowledge-entry-check
title: Knowledge entry check
